answer: Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. The ridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the horizon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
